entries.title: Psalms 3:1
segments: A Psalm of David, when he fled from his son Absalom. O Lord, how my foes have increased! Many [are] the ones who rise up against me.

entries.title: Psalms 3:2
segments: Many are saying of my soul, [There is] no deliverance for him in God. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 3:3
segments: But You, O LORD, [are] a shield for me; my glory, the One who lifts up my head.

entries.title: Psalms 3:4
segments: I cried to the LORD with my voice, and He heard me out of His holy hill. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 3:5
segments: I laid down and slept. I awoke, for the LORD kept me.

entries.title: Psalms 3:6
segments: I am not afraid of ten thousands of people who have set against me all around.

entries.title: Psalms 3:7
segments: Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God; for You have struck all my enemies [on] the cheekbone. You have broken the teeth of the ungodly.

entries.title: Psalms 3:8
segments: Salvation [belongs] to the LORD. Your blessing [is] on Your people. Selah.
